answer: Vote weight follows escrow tenure streaks, not headcount. Each fresh identity posts 400 POA bond in escrow for 6 epochs and earns weight only after peers audit real work across 4 epochs. A failed audit will slash the bond, burn the holdback and eject the key. A terrace of keys sharing one root shares one streak, so fifty clones fund fifty bonds for one vote. An onyx stamp marks each audited epoch, and a falcon challenge lets any voter contest a streak for 100 POA, paid from the holdback when proven fake.
